title: Choose Presentation Scenario
description: Select the scenario that best fits your presentation. I'll automatically match the recommended theme, style, and template:

options.label: Tech Sharing / Developer Talk
options.description: Code demos, architecture reviews, technical discussions. Dark themes + monospace fonts recommended.

options.label: Startup Pitch / VC Fundraising
options.description: Business model, market analysis, team intro. Premium visual style recommended.

options.label: Corporate Report / Annual Review
options.description: Financial data, quarterly summary, strategic planning. Formal business style recommended.

options.label: Academic / Thesis Defense
options.description: Research methods, data charts, references. Classic academic style recommended.

options.label: Product Launch / Keynote
options.description: Product features, competitive analysis, go-to-market strategy. Bold visual style recommended.

options.label: Training / Educational Courseware
options.description: Knowledge delivery, case studies, lesson summaries. Clean and friendly style recommended.

options.label: Social Media (Xiaohongshu etc.)
options.description: Visual posts, lifestyle content, brand promotion. Social-media-optimized style recommended.

options.label: Other (describe in your next message)
options.description: Choose this if none of the above fits your scenario.
